meta.title: PR Preview
meta.description: Read the description, comments and reviews of the current branch's pull request or merge request in the right sidebar.

title: PR / MR
description: The PR or MR pushed from this session's current branch
empty: No PR or MR is associated with the current branch. Push this branch and create a request first.
hint: Install gh (GitHub), glab (GitLab) or tea 0.12.x (Gitea/Forgejo) and sign in on the DSH host.
repository: No Git repository or remote was found for this session.
unsupported: Host not recognized. Check that the host is supported and review this session's repository connection settings.
cli_missing: The required CLI is missing or unsupported on the DSH host. Gitea and Forgejo use tea 0.12.x.
command_failed: Could not load requests. Check CLI authentication, repository access and the session's sandbox network policy.
invalid_response: The CLI returned an invalid response.
unavailable: Requests are unavailable. Reconnect and refresh.
link_unsupported: This link is outside the session's remote repository or uses an unsupported host. Open the original link below.
review_hint: Check the changes and checks in the official Forge panel first. Actions use your CLI account; authors cannot approve their own requests.
gitlab_review_hint: GitLab supports comments and approvals here. Approval cannot include text; submit a separate comment first. Requesting changes is available on the original page.
completed: Action completed. Refresh to verify the remote state.
action_failed: The action could not be confirmed. Refresh and check the remote state before retrying; it may already have completed. Check permissions and repository rules.
stale_request: The branch, request or head commit changed. Refresh and review again.
details_error: Some details could not be loaded. Refresh before reviewing.
